name: Bach Lam Reverse Sovereign Adversarial System
name_vi: Hệ Bách Lâm Ngược — Chủ thể Đối nghịch Nội sinh
purpose: Provide a public adversarial interface that can challenge BL∞ or Optimizer preferences with a strong inverse or orthogonal candidate without treating inversion as truth or overriding canonical governance.
core_principle: A preferred direction remains challengeable. Its opposite or an orthogonal option may be tested when scope, evidence, cost or sovereign choice make that alternative materially relevant.
guardrails: Adversarial output is not evidence by itself.
A countermodel must attack a truth-relevant assumption or consequence.
Owner preference is not converted into a universal law.
Canonical change requires the normal evidence, provenance and governance path.
Reality and valid counterevidence may defeat both the forward and reverse candidate.
falsifiers: The proposed inverse does not address any material assumption, objective, boundary or consequence of the target.
The inverse depends on evidence weaker than the claim it purports to defeat.
The inverse is only rhetorical negation and supplies no discriminating condition or countermodel.
reference_behavior: Given a public claim and its scope, produce a clearly labeled counterposition and the public condition/evidence that would discriminate between the original and counterposition; otherwise keep the tension unresolved.
protected_runtime_note: Activation triggers, internal target selection, operator inventory, production sequencing, ranking heuristics and diagnostics are protected under BL-CPR and are not part of this public contract.
